quote: It would be worse than finding rabbit fossils in the pre-Cambrian.
content: Transferring an already functional biological system differs from generating an integrated new ability through an ordinary mutation from scratch. The quoted scenario specifies the latter, so horizontal transfer and endosymbiosis do not instantiate its causal claim. 'Outright falsify' is still too hasty: one should first investigate the origin of the capacity and possible hidden mechanisms rather than discard evolutionary theory on the basis of an unexplained observation.

quote: And yet they have no idea of what the theory of evolutionary biology permits and prohibits.
content: A finding that acceptance tracks identity more closely than understanding is compatible with the essay's proposed distinction between scientific knowledge and allegiance. Political polarization among knowledgeable people does not show that knowing a theory's consequences has no value, only that knowledge does not automatically dissolve group motivation. Fable thus supplies a limitation on a possible cure while presenting it as a mismatch between the diagnosis and the data.

quote: Their devastating critiques consist purely of comparisons to apocalyptic literature, rather than, say, known laws which prohibit such an outcome.
content: Failure to identify a law prohibiting advanced AI is not positive evidence that a particular development trajectory will occur. The proponents owe a positive argument, while a comparison to apocalyptic fiction remains a weak rebuttal to whatever argument they supply. Fable correctly insists on symmetrical burdens, but empirical work can specify a learning mechanism before researchers completely understand why every capability emerges from it.
